title: Financial Literacy Basics
tagline: Understand how money actually works — compounding, credit, taxes, and risk — without the sales pitch.
curricula: CFPB financial well-being framework and Jump$tart Coalition national standards
disclaimer: Strictly conceptual education — never financial, investment, or tax advice, and no product recommendations. For guidance, see consumerfinance.gov and investor.gov.
endpoint: from paycheck confusion to understanding compounding, credit, and risk
about: Personal finance is the working knowledge of how money behaves — earning, spending, saving, borrowing, and the quiet arithmetic of compounding that rewards or punishes over decades. This category teaches the concepts: budgets, credit, interest, taxes, insurance, and risk, so that financial decisions are made with understanding rather than hope.
